project: Factory-to-Customer Shipping Route Efficiency Analysis — Nassau Candy Distributor

dataset.source: Unified Mentor project dataset (Nassau Candy Distributor, synthetic)
dataset.disclosure: Synthetic dataset supplied with the official project specification.

Shipping Lead Time.definition: Recovered true lead = (Ship Date − Order Date − 904) mod 365, in days. The raw gap carries a systematic multi-year timestamp defect (documented); the recovery strips it and is validated against ship-mode semantics.

Average Lead Time.definition: Mean recovered shipping lead time over the lines in scope (network, route, state, or mode level).

Route Volume.definition: Number of order lines on the route (Factory → Customer State/Province). Lines, not distinct orders — the grain is order-line.

Delay Frequency.definition: Share of a scope's lines whose recovered lead time exceeds the delay threshold (default 5 days, adjustable in the dashboard).

Route Efficiency Score.definition: 100 × (1 − (route avg lead − min avg lead) / (max avg lead − min avg lead)), computed over routes with at least 20 lines. Fastest rankable route = 100, slowest = 0. Small-sample routes are listed with raw stats but excluded from scoring.

Sales / Gross Profit.definition: Line-level Sales and Gross Profit summed over the scope. Gross Profit = Sales − Cost (identity verified on all rows).
